assessments.reasoning: The generated file at SPDX data commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48 contains the matching licenseId and deprecatedVersion on the license element. Under obsoletedBys, the AGPL-3.0-only child has no expression attribute. The AGPL-3.0-or-later child has expression="AGPL-3.0+". Both replacement values match identifiers in the separately opened records at the same commit.

The pinned SPDX ListedLicense.xsd distinguishes deprecatedVersion from listVersionAdded. Its obsoletedByType annotation gives a matching expression precedence and uses the unqualified entry as the fallback for the short identifier. The schema illustrates the rule with GPL identifiers, but the rule itself applies to the AGPL record's elements in the same SPDX namespace.

challenge.method: I tested whether the first replacement could apply to both inputs by comparing the expression attributes of both elements and applying the schema separately to AGPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0+.
challenge.results: Only the plus-suffixed input matches the explicit expression attribute. That match selects AGPL-3.0-or-later even though its element appears second. For the bare input the fallback selects AGPL-3.0-only. The later-version example in the license exhibit does not change either lookup.

limitations: These replacements are SPDX guidance for maintaining license expressions. Determining the grant for a particular work requires evidence about that work.

All eight acquisitions returned HTTP 200 and supplied source_text. All eight ranges arrays were empty, so I checked the named elements, attributes and documentation passages directly in the bodies. The connector-reported claim digests matched the three frozen digests. I did not independently recompute SHA-256 over the delivered UTF-8 bodies.
reasoning: The SPDX License List 3.29.0 record identifies AGPL-3.0 by the name GNU Affero General Public License v3.0. Its deprecatedVersion value is 3.0, which the schema defines as the first License List release to record deprecation. Applying the schema to the two obsoletedBy elements gives AGPL-3.0-only for the bare identifier and AGPL-3.0-or-later for the expression AGPL-3.0+.
